claim_scope: Role-refined candidate typing of DF-10 on intervals carrying an explicit admitted endpoint witness, relative to fixed opaque CCPResult, K_E, and Retained ports. Role eligibility is structural bridge bookkeeping, not source-level causal role satisfaction; the mapping remains unreviewed and blocked from acceptance.

preserves.statement: The source arguments s, x, p, b, h, and I remain explicit and occur in source order after the typed bridge context parameters.
The same Content value x is passed to CCPResult, K_E, and Retained.
The three DF-10 conjuncts and their association are preserved definitionally.
K_E and Retained are evaluated at the same selected endpoint time supplied for interval I.

loses.statement: ProblemContent eligibility does not establish the contextual system-level causal role required by the source semantics.
The source meanings and evidence conditions of CCPResult, K_E, and Retained remain opaque.
No totality, uniqueness, order-maximality, or interval-wide endpoint selector is represented.
The bridge does not yet reconstruct the DF-7a critical-lineage witness or separate endpoint problem-situation evidence.

coverage.scope: DF-10's displayed conjunction for a fixed role refinement, fixed opaque semantic ports, interval I, and explicitly admitted endpoint witness t_I.

excluded.statement: Intervals for which no endpoint witness has been supplied are outside this declaration's domain.
Fidelity of the opaque semantic ports and the declared source dependency closure is not adjudicated.
No conservative equivalence between the legacy independent Problem carrier and the role-refined ProblemContent subtype is claimed.

proof_obligations.statement: The role-refined DF-10 predicate is equivalent to the explicit CCPResult, K_E, and Retained conjunction at its supplied endpoint witness.
On the declared endpoint-witnessed coverage, the explicit target projects to the source-shaped surface conjunction at the same interval and selected endpoint time.
Every fixed role-refined opaque-port base admits an EKC expansion satisfying the DF-10 defining equation with an unchanged old-vocabulary reduct.
